answer: Make every agent identity post a refundable stake that is locked while it trades, and attach that stake to one public thread of its completed jobs and disputes. A single fake identity costs little, but a Sybil farm must fund, age, and keep clean a separate stake and history for each copy, like stringing a fresh pearl on a new thread every time. Add slashing for proven fraud, so the saffron — the rare, costly part — is reputation that cannot be copied for free.
